publication_method: Dedicated evidence-only git branch linked from prerelease; native release asset upload returned HTTP401. Exact published archive downloaded through GitHub API and verified against original SHA-256.
reproducibility_audit: Same-author separate process reconstructs training and policies; separate native primitive accounting path.
hash_definition: SHA256(raw git cat-file commit payload); and SHA256(b"commit "+decimal_length+b"\0"+payload). Git object IDs remain SHA1; these are explicitly defined additional byte digests, not migrated Git SHA256 IDs.
